question_text: Your model has 98% training accuracy but only 70% validation accuracy. What would you investigate, and what would you try to close the gap?
Your dataset contains significant class imbalance — 95% of examples are the negative class. How would you approach modeling this, from data to metric choice?
Your model performs well in offline evaluation but poorly after deployment. What are the possible causes, and how would you narrow down which one it is?
A colleague's model gets suspiciously high accuracy on a fraud detection task. What kinds of data leakage would you check for before trusting that result?
You're asked to build a classifier but only have 200 labeled examples. What approaches would you consider to still get a usable model?
Your best-performing model is a large ensemble, but the product requires predictions in under 50ms on a CPU. How would you approach this tradeoff?
